_docs: Ability Registry — the source of truth for ability wiring. Each ability in src/data/abilities.json gets one entry here documenting HOW it's wired into the game. STATUS VALUES: 'wired' = has code references, modifiers, or synergy participation. 'partial' = synergy-only (no direct code path). 'dead' = no wiring at all (flag for Steve, do not delete). ORPHAN CODE REFS: ability IDs referenced in code but missing from abilities.json. DEAD ACTIVE DEFS: abilities with an 'active' field that no code reads (the active/cooldown system was never built). To add a new ability: 1) add to abilities.json, 2) add entry here with wiring info, 3) run scripts/validate-ability-registry.js.

orphanCodeRefs.note: hasAbility('observer') check; no such ability in abilities.json. Likely renamed or never added.
hasAbility('social_read') checks; no such ability in abilities.json. Likely renamed or never added.

deadActiveDefs.note: Active/cooldown system was never implemented. No code reads the 'active' field.

triage.name: Triage
triage.description: Stop bleeding, set bones, treat infection. Your hands remember the ER.

synergyHints: Adrenaline Control: stabilize then fight on

steady_hands.name: Steady Hands
steady_hands.description: Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.

game_sense.name: Game Sense
game_sense.description: Read sign: tracks, scat, browse lines. You know what's been here and how long ago.

synergyHints: Patient Aim: find it, then drop it clean

patient_aim.name: Patient Aim
patient_aim.description: One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.

field_dressing.name: Field Dressing
field_dressing.description: Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.

synergyHints: Preservation Instinct: harvest, then keep it

preservation_instinct.name: Preservation Instinct
preservation_instinct.description: You think in shelf life. Smoking, drying, salting — food that lasts is food that saves.

forage_identification.name: Forage Identification
forage_identification.description: Tell dandelion from disaster at a glance. The woods start talking.

iron_stomach.name: Iron Stomach
iron_stomach.description: Your gut handles what it shouldn't. A useful lie your body tells itself.

soft_step.name: Soft Step
soft_step.description: Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.

taught_hands.name: Taught Hands
taught_hands.description: Someone taught you this over a long winter. Knowledge is the only inheritance.

pattern_recognition.name: Pattern Recognition
pattern_recognition.description: The System noticed you noticing patterns. It approves, in its way.

adrenaline_control.name: Adrenaline Control
adrenaline_control.description: Burn bright, pay later. Once per expedition, act twice.

green_thumb.name: Green Thumb
green_thumb.description: Foraging yields +50%. You know where to look.

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.description: Hunting success +30%. You read the ground.

diplomat.name: Diplomat
diplomat.description: Trust builds 2x faster. People open up to you.

camp_cook.name: Camp Cook
camp_cook.description: Cooking uses half the water. +10% kcal.

squirrel_friend.name: Squirrel Friend
squirrel_friend.description: Squirrels sometimes leave you nuts. (Random gifts.)

rain_dancer.name: Rain Dancer
rain_dancer.description: When it rains, +1L water free. (You dance. It works.)

loud_chewer.name: Loud Chewer
loud_chewer.description: Eating is 2x louder (monsters hear you). But +5 morale.

hoarder.name: Hoarder
hoarder.description: +10kg carry, but villagers trust you 20% less. (They notice.)

thief.name: Light Fingers
thief.description: Steal from pantry without trust loss (50%). If caught, -20 trust.

photosynthesis.name: Photosynthesis
photosynthesis.description: Gain 100 kcal/hour in sunlight. (You're becoming a plant.)

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Once per day, when you'd die, you don't. (1 HP, 500 kcal.)

lucky_rock.name: Lucky Rock
lucky_rock.description: Your lucky rock. +5% to everything. (It's not the rock. It's you believing in the rock. The System finds this adorable and helps a little.)

bird_whisperer.name: Bird Whisperer
bird_whisperer.description: Birds land on you. They also warn you: +20% chance to detect monsters before they detect you. (The birds see everything.)

chitin_skin.name: Chitin Skin
chitin_skin.description: Your skin hardens into plates. +30 armor, but -20% trust (you look wrong).

extra_stomach.name: Extra Stomach
extra_stomach.description: You grow a second stomach. Bank twice the calories — but the hunger doubles too. (It's always hungry.)

deep_reserves.name: Deep Reserves
deep_reserves.description: Your body learns to bank calories like a war chest. Bank 5× the energy. The furnace is always lit — but it must be FED.

eyes_in_back.name: Eyes in the Back
eyes_in_back.description: You see behind you. Can't be ambushed. But you see... things. (-5 morale when alone.)

molt.name: Molt
molt.description: Once per week, shed your skin. Heal to full, but lose all equipped gear (it's stuck in the old skin).

blood_magic.name: Blood Price
blood_magic.description: Spend 10 HP to gain 500 kcal. (Your body eats itself. It's efficient. It's horrifying.)

rage.name: Berserker Rage
rage.description: +100% damage, but you attack the nearest thing (friend or foe). Lasts 3 rounds.

cannibal_frenzy.name: Red Hunger
cannibal_frenzy.description: When starving, you can eat anything (even people). +1000 kcal, but -30 trust permanently.

pact.name: Pact with Static
pact.description: Gain a random overpowered ability, but lose a random utility ability. (The Static gives. The Static takes.)

scream_cheese.name: Scream Cheese
scream_cheese.description: You can scream so loud it curdles milk (and stuns monsters for 1 round). 1/day.

pocket_sand.name: Pocket Sand
pocket_sand.description: Throw sand in eyes. Blinds for 2 rounds. (You always have sand. Don't ask where.)

taste_vision.name: Taste Vision
taste_vision.description: You can taste colors. (Reveals hidden loot: +30% find chance in ruins. The walls taste like secrets.)

poisoner.name: Poisoner
poisoner.description: You can poison food/water. (Useful against monsters. Or... others.)

fear_aura.name: Dread
fear_aura.description: Villagers and monsters are uneasy around you. -10 trust, but monsters hesitate (+1 round before attacking).

grave_robber.name: Grave Robber
grave_robber.description: You can loot the dead (villagers, monsters). Good gear. -15 trust if seen.

time_skip.name: Time Skip
time_skip.description: Skip to the next day part instantly. (Ages you 1 day. The time has to come from somewhere.)

hive_mind.name: Hive Mind
hive_mind.description: You know what all villagers are doing (map reveals). But they know what YOU'RE doing too. (-10 trust.)

ant_trail.name: Ant Trail
ant_trail.description: You can follow ant trails to water and sugar. Ants know things.

cold_blooded.name: Cold-Blooded
cold_blooded.description: You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.

echo_location.name: Echo Location
echo_location.description: Clap once: you sense the layout of any 9x9 grid (reveals blocked cells). 1/day.

compost_king.name: Compost King
compost_king.description: Spoiled food becomes fertilizer: bury it, and forage yields +10% on that tile next season.

beard_moss.name: Beard Moss
beard_moss.description: Moss grows in your beard/hair. You always have tinder. (Looks great, honestly.)

dowsing.name: Dowsing
dowsing.description: A forked stick twitches toward water. Works 70% of the time. Nobody knows why. Including us.

cornered_rat.name: Cornered Rat
cornered_rat.description: When surrounded (3+ enemies), +100% damage and +50% dodge. Desperation is a weapon.

dead_aim.name: Dead Aim
dead_aim.description: First attack in any combat is a guaranteed critical if you waited 1 round. Patience, then thunder.

second_skin.name: Second Skin
second_skin.description: Your armor never slows you. Move full speed in any armor. You wear it like weather.

open_book.name: Open Book
open_book.description: Villagers tell you their real trust level and one secret fear. You just... know how to ask.

mediator.name: Mediator
mediator.description: You can resolve villager disputes (drama events) with a talk check. Peace is a skill.

leech.name: Leech
leech.description: When an ally takes damage near you, you can take half of it. They owe you. (They know it.)

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.description: You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.

hollow_bones.name: Hollow Bones
hollow_bones.description: You weigh 30% less for carry calculations. Your bones are birdlike. (Don't think about it.)

third_eye.name: Third Eye
third_eye.description: A small eye opens on your forehead when danger is near. +30% ambush detection. It weeps when you lie.

phoenix_clause.name: Phoenix Clause
phoenix_clause.description: Once per run: when you die, you explode (damaging everything nearby) and respawn at Haven with 1 HP. The System calls it 'great television.'

symbiote.name: Symbiote
symbiote.description: A small alien organism lives in your gut. It eats 200 kcal/day but warns you of poisoned food and purifies risky water slowly (1L/day).

swimmer.name: Swimmer
swimmer.description: Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.

night_eyes.name: Night Eyes
night_eyes.description: Your eyes drink the dark. At night you spot trouble before it spots you, and nocturnal game can't hide from a patient hunter.

translator.name: Translator
translator.description: The System logs every foreign word you hear and replays them on demand — a memory aid, not a shortcut. Novel speech stays novel until YOU learn it. (Deep integration may wake it up further.)

field_medicine.name: Field Medicine
field_medicine.description: Clean wounds, poultice infections, set bones in the field. Heal 20 HP (once per day part).

herbal_remedy.name: Herbal Remedy
herbal_remedy.description: You know which plants draw fever out. Cure disease.

purify.name: Purify
purify.description: Charcoal, clean water, time. Neutralize poison.
